en-GB.story.heading: Our Story
en-GB.story.subtitle: The important checkpoints of our relationship
en-GB.story.timeline.0.title: First Met
en-GB.story.timeline.0.description: We met on an exploration trip, with our friends Xavier and Katulin. We went to Geres for the day and we couldn't stop laughing together.
en-GB.story.timeline.1.title: First Date
en-GB.story.timeline.1.description: Our first official date was in Porto for a pleasent weekend together. After that we kept videochatting non-stop.
en-GB.story.timeline.2.title: Moved In Together
en-GB.story.timeline.2.description: When João moved to Brno, Zuza ended up spending most of her days with him. At the end of 2021, João asked her to officially moved in.
en-GB.story.timeline.3.title: Taco
en-GB.story.timeline.3.description: After getting out of a no-dogs apartment and Zuza having graduated, we decided to get ourselves a dog. Taco became our first baby.
en-GB.story.timeline.4.title: The House
en-GB.story.timeline.4.description: After a few months searching for a house, without any expectation, we stumbled upon the one we now call home. This is where we will welcome you on our special day.
en-GB.story.timeline.5.title: The Proposal
en-GB.story.timeline.5.description: In Vienna, Joao bent the knee (this might only make sense in English, sorry grandma) and asked the question. Zuza obviously said yes, otherwise we would not be here.
en-GB.story.timeline.6.title: The little (big) one
en-GB.story.timeline.6.description: In order to break tradition, our baby came before the wedding (sorry Jesus).
en-GB.story.timeline.7.title: Our Wedding Day
en-GB.story.timeline.7.description: And now we're here! We're so excited to celebrate this special day with all of you. Thank you for being part of our journey.
en-GB.story.closing.heading: And the adventure continues...
en-GB.story.closing.body: We can't wait to write the next chapter with all of you by our side.

en-GB.details.venue.parking.heading: Parking Information
en-GB.details.venue.parking.body: There are parking spots throughout the village. Several can be found on the main street, others behind the church or at the village end. Lesná is a rather small village so you'll be walking 5 minutes at most.
en-GB.details.schedule.heading: Schedule
en-GB.details.schedule.ceremony.title: Ceremony
en-GB.details.schedule.ceremony.body: The wedding ceremony begins. Please arrive 15 minutes early to find your seat.
en-GB.details.schedule.cocktail.title: Cocktail Hour
en-GB.details.schedule.cocktail.body: Enjoy drinks and appetizers while the wedding party takes photos.
en-GB.details.schedule.reception.title: Reception

en-GB.details.schedule.lastdance.title: Last Dance
en-GB.details.dresscode.heading: Dress Code
en-GB.details.dresscode.intro: We want you to feel comfortable! Note that we will be in the garden so choose your footwear wisely. For your own sakes, don't bring high heels:
en-GB.details.dresscode.item1: For guests: Festive dresses, nice slacks with a shirt, no need for suit
en-GB.details.dresscode.item2: Colors to avoid: White, ivory, or anything that might look bridal. Don't bring black, this is not a funeral.
en-GB.details.dresscode.item3: Colors to avoid: White, ivory, or anything that might look bridal
en-GB.details.dresscode.colors.label: Wedding Colors:
en-GB.details.dresscode.colors.value: Yellow, Pink, Purple, Red, Green, etc. You can get the vibes from the website and your paper invite.
en-GB.details.dresscode.colors.note: (Feel free to incorporate these colors, but it's not required!)
en-GB.details.accommodation.heading: Accommodation
en-GB.details.accommodation.help: Need help with accommodation or want to stay with us (house or backyard)? Please let us know in your RSVP, and we'll be happy to assist you with booking or recommendations!
en-GB.details.faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
en-GB.details.faq.plusone.a: Due to venue capacity, we can only accommodate guests formally invited. If you received a plus-one, it will be indicated on your invitation and RSVP.
en-GB.details.faq.children.a: Children are welcome! Just let us know if you're planning to bring your little one in the extra notes in the RSVP so that we can prepare accordingly.
en-GB.details.faq.dietary.q: What if I have dietary restrictions?
en-GB.details.faq.dietary.a: Please let us know about any dietary restrictions or allergies in your RSVP, and we'll make sure to accommodate you!
en-GB.details.faq.transport.a: Yes, there will be a bus taking guests from the city/ place where the ceremony will take place to the venue. In the evening/night, there will be a driver taking guests to their homes/hotels.
en-GB.details.faq.weather.a: July in South Moravia is usually sunny and quite warm (25/35 degrees) with the nights around the 15 degrees mark.
en-GB.details.faq.gifts.a: Your presence is the greatest gift! However, if you'd like to give a gift, a financial contribution would be the most appreciated.
en-GB.details.contact.heading: Have More Questions?
en-GB.details.contact.body: Feel free to reach out to us directly!
en-GB.photos.heading: Wedding Photos
en-GB.photos.subtitle: Share your favorite moments from our special day
en-GB.photos.upload.heading: Upload Your Photos
en-GB.photos.upload.intro: We'd love to see the wedding through your eyes! Please upload any photos or videos you took during the celebration to our shared Google Drive folder.
en-GB.photos.upload.step1.heading: Click the button below
en-GB.photos.upload.step1.body: This will open our shared Google Drive folder
en-GB.photos.upload.step2.heading: Upload your photos
en-GB.photos.upload.step2.body: Click "New" → "File upload" or simply drag and drop your photos
en-GB.photos.upload.step3.heading: That's it!
en-GB.photos.upload.step3.body: We'll be able to see all the wonderful photos you share
en-GB.photos.upload.body: Share your photos from our special day and we'll add them to our wedding album.
en-GB.photos.upload.success: Photos uploaded successfully! Thank you for sharing.
en-GB.photos.empty.heading: No Photos Yet
en-GB.photos.empty.body: Be the first to share a photo from our special day!
en-GB.photos.login.heading: Login Required
en-GB.photos.login.body: Please log in with your invitation credentials to view and upload wedding photos.
en-GB.photos.upload.note: You may need to sign in to your Google account to upload photos. Don't worry - we can't see your personal information, only the photos you upload to our folder!
en-GB.photos.alt.heading: Alternative: Google Photos
en-GB.photos.alt.body: Prefer Google Photos? We also have a shared album there!
en-GB.photos.guidelines.heading: Photo Guidelines
en-GB.photos.guidelines.1: Upload as many photos as you'd like - we want to see them all!
en-GB.photos.guidelines.2: Videos are welcome too! Share those candid moments and speeches.
en-GB.photos.guidelines.3: Original quality is preferred - don't worry about file size!
en-GB.photos.guidelines.4: Please upload within a week or two while the memories are fresh!
en-GB.photos.thanks.heading: Thank You for Sharing!
en-GB.photos.thanks.body: We can't wait to relive all the special moments through your photos. Your memories will help make our wedding album complete!
en-GB.login.heading: Welcome
en-GB.login.subtitle: Please log in to continue
en-GB.login.field.username.hint: From your invitation (e.g., John & Emma would be JoEm)
en-GB.login.why.heading: Why do I need to log in?
en-GB.login.why.body: Login credentials ensure that only invited guests can RSVP. Your username and PIN were included in your wedding invitation. This helps us track responses accurately and prevent spam RSVPs. With your login you'll also be able to add photos to the Google Drive and suggest songs through Spotify.

el.story.timeline.0.title: First Met
el.story.timeline.0.description: We met on an exploration trip, with our friends Xavier and Katulin. We went to Geres for the day and we couldn't stop laughing together.
el.story.timeline.1.title: First Date
el.story.timeline.1.description: Our first official date was in Porto for a pleasent weekend together. After that we kept videochatting non-stop.
el.story.timeline.2.title: Moved In Together
el.story.timeline.2.description: When João moved to Brno, Zuza ended up spending most of her days with him. At the end of 2021, João asked her to officially moved in.
el.story.timeline.3.title: Taco
el.story.timeline.3.description: After getting out of a no-dogs apartment and Zuza having graduated, we decided to get ourselves a dog. Taco became our first baby.
el.story.timeline.4.title: The House
el.story.timeline.4.description: After a few months searching for a house, without any expectation, we stumbled upon the one we now call home. This is where we will welcome you on our special day.
el.story.timeline.5.title: The Proposal
el.story.timeline.5.description: In Vienna, Joao bent the knee (this might only make sense in English, sorry grandma) and asked the question. Zuza obviously said yes, otherwise we would not be here.
el.story.timeline.6.title: The little (big) one
el.story.timeline.6.description: In order to break tradition, our baby came before the wedding (sorry Jesus).
el.story.timeline.7.title: Our Wedding Day
el.story.timeline.7.description: And now we're here! We're so excited to celebrate this special day with all of you. Thank you for being part of our journey.
el.story.closing.heading: And the adventure continues...
el.story.closing.body: We can't wait to write the next chapter with all of you by our side.

el.details.faq.children.a: Children are welcome! Just let us know if you're planning to bring your little one in the extra notes in the RSVP so that we can prepare accordingly.
el.details.faq.dietary.q: What if I have dietary restrictions?
el.details.faq.dietary.a: Please let us know about any dietary restrictions or allergies in your RSVP, and we'll make sure to accommodate you!
el.details.faq.transport.a: Yes, there will be a bus taking guests from the city/ place where the ceremony will take place to the venue. In the evening/night, there will be a driver taking guests to their homes/hotels.
el.details.faq.weather.a: July in South Moravia is usually sunny and quite warm (25/35 degrees) with the nights around the 15 degrees mark.
el.details.faq.gifts.a: Your presence is the greatest gift! However, if you'd like to give a gift, a financial contribution would be the most appreciated.

el.details.contact.body: Feel free to reach out to us directly!

da.story.timeline.0.title: First Met
da.story.timeline.0.description: We met on an exploration trip, with our friends Xavier and Katulin. We went to Geres for the day and we couldn't stop laughing together.
da.story.timeline.1.title: First Date
da.story.timeline.1.description: Our first official date was in Porto for a pleasent weekend together. After that we kept videochatting non-stop.
da.story.timeline.2.title: Moved In Together
da.story.timeline.2.description: When João moved to Brno, Zuza ended up spending most of her days with him. At the end of 2021, João asked her to officially moved in.
da.story.timeline.3.title: Taco
da.story.timeline.3.description: After getting out of a no-dogs apartment and Zuza having graduated, we decided to get ourselves a dog. Taco became our first baby.
da.story.timeline.4.title: The House
da.story.timeline.4.description: After a few months searching for a house, without any expectation, we stumbled upon the one we now call home. This is where we will welcome you on our special day.
da.story.timeline.5.title: The Proposal
da.story.timeline.5.description: In Vienna, Joao bent the knee (this might only make sense in English, sorry grandma) and asked the question. Zuza obviously said yes, otherwise we would not be here.
da.story.timeline.6.title: The little (big) one
da.story.timeline.6.description: In order to break tradition, our baby came before the wedding (sorry Jesus).
da.story.timeline.7.title: Our Wedding Day
da.story.timeline.7.description: And now we're here! We're so excited to celebrate this special day with all of you. Thank you for being part of our journey.
da.story.closing.heading: And the adventure continues...
da.story.closing.body: We can't wait to write the next chapter with all of you by our side.

fr.details.faq.children.a: Children are welcome! Just let us know if you're planning to bring your little one in the extra notes in the RSVP so that we can prepare accordingly.
fr.details.faq.dietary.q: What if I have dietary restrictions?
fr.details.faq.dietary.a: Please let us know about any dietary restrictions or allergies in your RSVP, and we'll make sure to accommodate you!
fr.details.faq.transport.a: Yes, there will be a bus taking guests from the city/ place where the ceremony will take place to the venue. In the evening/night, there will be a driver taking guests to their homes/hotels.
fr.details.faq.weather.a: July in South Moravia is usually sunny and quite warm (25/35 degrees) with the nights around the 15 degrees mark.
fr.details.faq.gifts.a: Your presence is the greatest gift! However, if you'd like to give a gift, a financial contribution would be the most appreciated.
fr.details.contact.heading: Have More Questions?
fr.details.contact.body: Feel free to reach out to us directly!

fr.photos.upload.heading: Upload Your Photos
fr.photos.upload.intro: We'd love to see the wedding through your eyes! Please upload any photos or videos you took during the celebration to our shared Google Drive folder.
fr.photos.upload.step1.heading: Click the button below

fr.photos.upload.step2.heading: Upload your photos

fr.photos.upload.step3.heading: That's it!
fr.photos.upload.step3.body: We'll be able to see all the wonderful photos you share

fr.photos.login.heading: Login Required
fr.photos.login.body: Please log in with your invitation credentials to view and upload wedding photos.
fr.photos.upload.note: You may need to sign in to your Google account to upload photos. Don't worry - we can't see your personal information, only the photos you upload to our folder!
fr.photos.alt.heading: Alternative: Google Photos
fr.photos.alt.body: Prefer Google Photos? We also have a shared album there!
fr.photos.guidelines.heading: Photo Guidelines
fr.photos.guidelines.1: Upload as many photos as you'd like - we want to see them all!
fr.photos.guidelines.2: Videos are welcome too! Share those candid moments and speeches.
fr.photos.guidelines.3: Original quality is preferred - don't worry about file size!
fr.photos.guidelines.4: Please upload within a week or two while the memories are fresh!
fr.photos.thanks.heading: Thank You for Sharing!
fr.photos.thanks.body: We can't wait to relive all the special moments through your photos. Your memories will help make our wedding album complete!

fr.login.why.heading: Why do I need to log in?
fr.login.why.body: Login credentials ensure that only invited guests can RSVP. Your username and PIN were included in your wedding invitation. This helps us track responses accurately and prevent spam RSVPs. With your login you'll also be able to add photos to the Google Drive and suggest songs through Spotify.
